item.text: RB Jadarian Price ruled out by Seattle Seahawks for Week 4. The Seattle Seahawks on Friday ruled out running back Jadarian Price for their game Sunday against the Los Angeles Chargers, as the rookie deals with a chest injury suffered in Week 2 and aggravated in practice Wednesday, according to Mike Macdonald.

Texans get WR Nico Collins (hamstring) back vs. Cowboys. The winless Texans got good news Friday as star wide receiver Nico Collins is set to return Sunday from a hamstring injury that forced him to miss Houston's last two games.

note: availability item; the trade is backstory

item.text: Joey Porter Jr. without designation, could debut for Cowboys. Newly acquired Cowboys cornerback Joey Porter Jr. does not carry an injury designation after practicing the past two days following his trade from the Steelers.

note: reaction to a trade made this week, not the announcement

item.text: McCarthy: Trade to Giants a 'shock,' turns page on Vikings. Quarterback J.J. McCarthy said it was a "shock" to be traded from the Vikings to the Giants this week but is looking at it as an opportunity to show what he can do.

Ravens' Trey Hendrickson has surgery on finger, out vs. Titans. The Ravens will be without top pass rusher Trey Hendrickson against the Titans on Sunday after the outside linebacker had surgery for a broken finger.
Bears coach Ben Johnson not ready to name QB starter. Bears coach Ben Johnson will not say whether Case Keenum or Tyson Bagent will start Sunday against the Jets.
